verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents how to create, invoke, and install skills/plugins (SKILL.md files, marketplace add/install commands, disableBundledSkills setting) but contains no documentation of a command to list installed skills or to cleanly uninstall/remove a skill and its files/instructions without manual folder deletion. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The rationale concedes the evidence 'only touches this story indirectly' — removal-by-deleting-the-folder is inference, disableBundledSkills disables rather than uninstalls, and no list/remove flow or orphan guarantees are evidenced. Anthropic-affiliation governance, README §9.]
